design: Composition test. Rendezvous gait and command-conditioned swing share one physical episode and real state. Keep support clearance. No additional near-contact IK and no retuning. Predictions are not substituted for the measured soccer ball in the evidence. Compare with the same moving controller and fixed S0 swing.
placement: Offsets are -2.35*velocity+intercept_offset from the v161 nominal location. Original X at goal plane and speed tolerances remain unchanged. Development composition check, not validated pooling of earlier cohorts.
